## Load in Renv

```{r}
# Clear active workspace memory at the start of interactive runs
rm(list = ls())

# Make sure 'here' is available and loaded so relative paths can be used
if (!requireNamespace("here", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("here", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}
library(here)

# Self-contained renv bootstrap, load, and restore for fresh opens / clones
if (!requireNamespace("renv", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("renv", repos = "https://cloud.r-project.org")
}

if (file.exists(here("renv.lock"))) {
  # If a lockfile exists locally (e.g. freshly cloned or previously built),
  # load the environment and non-interactively restore dependencies.
  renv::load(project = here(), quiet = TRUE)
  tryCatch({
    renv::restore(project = here(), prompt = FALSE, clean = TRUE)
  }, error = function(e) {
    message("renv restore note: ", e$message)
  })
} else {
  # If this is a brand-new local folder with no lockfile, 
  # initialize a fresh bare renv without forcing a session restart.
  renv::init(project = here(), bare = TRUE, restart = FALSE)
}

# Force knitr to run all notebook chunks from the project root directory
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = here())

# Set global Quarto / R Markdown chunk options
knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  echo = TRUE,          # Show code chunks in final report
  warning = FALSE,      # Hide package execution warnings
  message = FALSE,      # Hide library load startup messages
  fig.width = 8,        # Standardize figure width
  fig.height = 5,       # Standardize figure height
  fig.align = "center"  # Center plot outputs
)

# Install and load all required project dependencies natively
source(here("code+nb/install_deps.R"))
```

## Analysis and Visualization Script

```{r}
source(here("code+nb/insect_analysis.R"))
```
